evidence_delta.march_2026_preprint: arXiv:2603.10168 publicly computes the graviton-mediated identical-scalar s+t+u amplitude and explicitly leaves the direct A4 contact term outside the calculation.
evidence_delta.september_2026_erg: ERG2026 public contribution by the same research programme states that the gravitational contact amplitude is resummed directly in Lorentzian signature and that the resulting cross-section is GR-compatible in the IR and respects unitarity in the UV.
evidence_delta.lorentzian_spectral_corroboration: arXiv:2606.19321 supplies normalisable Lorentzian graviton and scalar-graviton spectral functions, IR EFT agreement and a quadratic-curvature effective action, but no explicit source-level realization map to the ERG2026 contact-complete scalar-scattering calculation was located.
evidence_delta.distinct_contact_guard: arXiv:2602.21285 is a distinct two-species scalar scattering realization and is not imported as the A4 object for arXiv:2603.10168.

terminalization.reason: The ERG2026 presentation establishes material public progress but the machine-readable contact-amplitude formula, numerical/approximation/error ledger and explicit same-realization composition map are not yet available in the audited public payload.
